name: Brønnøysund Register Centre (Enhetsregisteret)
summary: Norway's Central Coordinating Register for Legal Entities: search and look up companies and their establishments by organisation number, with roles (board, CEO, auditor), group structure and change feeds.
notes: Keyless open data under the Norwegian licence for public data (NLOD).
An organisation number (organisasjonsnummer) is 9 digits. An enhet is a legal entity; an underenhet is one of its establishments (business locations).
Paging is page (0-based) and size, default 20; (page+1)*size may not exceed 10,000 or the call is a 400. For the full register use the nightly bulk downloads instead, which this entry does not list.
Parameter and field names are Norwegian. List filters take comma-separated values.

endpoints.name: Search legal entities
endpoints.summary: Legal entities (enheter) matching a name and filters: form, industry code, address, employees, registry flags, bankruptcy and dates.

navn.description: Entity name, free text of 1 to 180 characters.

navnMetodeForSoek.description: Name search method; the only value is FORTLOEPENDE (continuous match).

overordnetEnhet.description: Organisation number of the parent unit in the public sector.

organisasjonsform.description: Comma-separated organisation form codes, e.g. AS,ENK.

kommunenummer.description: Comma-separated 4-digit municipality numbers; matches the business or postal address.

forretningsadresse_postnummer.description: Comma-separated 4-digit postcodes of the business address.

forretningsadresse_poststed.description: Postal town of the business address, free text.

underAvvikling.description: Whether the entity is being wound up.

registrertIMvaregisteret.description: Whether the entity is in the VAT register.

registrertIForetaksregisteret.description: Whether the entity is in the Register of Business Enterprises.

fraRegistreringsdatoEnhetsregisteret.description: Earliest registration date in the register, yyyy-MM-dd.

tilRegistreringsdatoEnhetsregisteret.description: Latest registration date in the register, yyyy-MM-dd.

sort.description: Field and direction, e.g. antallAnsatte,DESC or organisasjonsnummer,ASC.

notes: Results stop at 10,000 per query: (page+1)*size over 10,000 is a 400.

endpoints.name: Get a legal entity
endpoints.summary: One legal entity by organisation number: name, form, addresses, industry codes, employees, founding date, registry flags and status.
notes: A deleted entity answers 410 Gone with its deletion date rather than 404.

endpoints.name: Get an entity's roles
endpoints.summary: Every role registered on an entity, by role group: CEO, board chair and members, auditor, accountant, contact person and more.
notes: Roles are public, but the register's law only allows showing a person's roles across entities for business entities, not voluntary organisations. Birth numbers need the separate authorised API (Maskinporten), not this one.

endpoints.name: Get roles an entity holds in other entities
endpoints.summary: The roles one entity holds in other entities, e.g. as participant, accountant or auditor.

searchAfter.description: Next batch: the last value from the previous batch.

notes: Pages with searchAfter (last value of the previous batch), not page numbers.

endpoints.name: Get a group structure
endpoints.summary: The hierarchy of companies linked to an entity (parent and subsidiaries in its corporate group).

endpoints.name: Search establishments
endpoints.summary: Sub-entities (underenheter, business locations) by name, parent entity, form, industry, location address, employees and dates.

navn.description: Establishment name, free text of 1 to 180 characters.

overordnetEnhet.description: Organisation number of the parent legal entity: lists its establishments.

organisasjonsform.description: Comma-separated organisation form codes, e.g. BEDR,AAFY.

kommunenummer.description: Comma-separated 4-digit municipality numbers; matches the location or postal address.

beliggenhetsadresse_postnummer.description: Comma-separated 4-digit postcodes of the location address.

notes: Results stop at 10,000 per query: (page+1)*size over 10,000 is a 400.

endpoints.name: Get an establishment
endpoints.summary: One sub-entity by organisation number: name, parent entity, location address, industry, employees and dates.

endpoints.name: List entity updates
endpoints.summary: Change events (new, changed, deleted, removed) on legal entities since a timestamp or update id.

dato.description: Updates published from this time on, yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'.

updatedBefore.description: Updates published up to this time, same format.

oppdateringsid.description: Only updates from this update id on (1 or more).

organisasjonsnummer.description: Comma-separated organisation numbers to limit the feed to.

includeChanges.description: Include the field changes behind each update.

notes: Each event names the entity and the change type; fetch the entity again for its new state. A Fjernet (removed) event means copies must drop the entity.
